section_1_cloze.passage:
Siberia is a huge region of Russia famous for its severe winters. Tom was trying to cycle across it on a freezing cold day. Everyone had told him it was a [41] idea. Maybe they were right...
Tom was so cold that he was trembling. He was [42] , so he was going faster and faster. Trees passed in a blur(模糊形状). He couldn't stop. This was going to end [43] . It was supposed to have been fun! But this was not fun at all.
Tom was about to crash. He was [44] down a big hill at top speed — in deep snow. His [45] could not make him come to a stop. All he could do was [46] tight! Waiting for the crash was almost worse than the crash itself.
Tom had no choice but to scream in the [47] of winter.
"Aaaaagggghhhhhhhh! Help!"
But nobody could help. Nobody even [48] his scream. Tom was alone. He was hundreds of miles from the [49] human.
CRASH!
Tom [50] face down in a snowdrift(雪堆). For a minute or two, he did not move. He was not sure whether he was [51] or not. Then slowly, Tom moved his toes. Then his fingers. Then his nose. Everything seemed to be in [52] .
The snow had cushioned(缓冲) his [53] . Tom was OK. But lying face down in the freezing snow was not a nice feeling, so Tom slowly [54] himself upright.
"Maybe I am really out of sense. Everyone says I am. I'm out here, in the middle of nowhere, on my own, on a bike, in the middle of winter. I've crashed on every [55] that I've ridden down today. This is stupid, but it's brilliant!"

questions.explanation: 根据前文提到在极寒的西伯利亚冬天骑自行车穿越，大家都认为这明显是个“疯狂的(crazy)”主意。A(好的)、B(新的)、D(独特的)均不符合人们对其危险行为的评价。
questions.supplement:
A(good)：语境句：Reading is a good habit that benefits us for a lifetime. 固定搭配：do good to, be good at
B(new)：语境句：The company has developed a new strategy to attract young customers. 固定搭配：brand new, make a new start
C(crazy)：语境句：It is a crazy idea to swim across the freezing river in winter. 固定搭配：drive sb. crazy, be crazy about
D(unique)：语境句：Each individual has their own unique fingerprints. 固定搭配：be unique to, unique style

questions.explanation: 前句提到他冷得发抖，因此他可能已经被“冻伤(frost-bitten)”或极度受寒，为了取暖只能越骑越快。A(心碎的)、B(意志坚强的)、C(张口结舌的)均不符合身体受寒的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(heart-broken)：语境句：She was completely heart-broken when her pet dog passed away. 固定搭配：feel heart-broken, a heart-broken mother
B(iron-willed)：语境句：The iron-willed athlete overcame severe injuries to win the championship. 固定搭配：an iron-willed leader, iron-willed determination
C(tongue-tied)：语境句：He was so nervous during the interview that he stood there tongue-tied. 固定搭配：be tongue-tied, leave sb tongue-tied
D(frost-bitten)：语境句：The climbers' fingers were frost-bitten after days in the snowstorm. 固定搭配：frost-bitten toes, get frost-bitten

questions.explanation: 根据前句“他无法停下来”以及后文的撞车，可知这件事情的结局将会“很糟糕(badly)”。A(顺利地)、B(突然地)、D(和平地)均不符合失控即将撞车的危机感。
questions.supplement:
A(smoothly)：语境句：Thanks to everyone's effort, the project went smoothly. 固定搭配：go smoothly, run smoothly
B(suddenly)：语境句：The sky turned dark suddenly and it began to pour. 固定搭配：stop suddenly, appear suddenly
C(badly)：语境句：The building was badly damaged in the terrible earthquake. 固定搭配：be badly hurt, end badly
D(peacefully)：语境句：The old man passed away peacefully in his sleep. 固定搭配：live peacefully, solve a problem peacefully

questions.explanation: 他正骑着自行车以最高速冲下大山，flying 在此处引申为“飞驰，极速移动”，生动地描绘了失控冲下山坡的场景。A(攀爬)方向错误，C(滑雪)和D(开车)与自行车不符。
questions.supplement:
A(climbing)：语境句：We spent the whole morning climbing the steep mountain. 固定搭配：go climbing, mountain climbing
B(flying)：语境句：The boys were flying down the hill on their skateboards. 固定搭配：send sth flying, flying down (飞驰而下)
C(skiing)：语境句：They usually go skiing in the Alps during the winter holidays. 固定搭配：go skiing, water skiing
D(driving)：语境句：He is driving his new car to work today. 固定搭配：driving license, safe driving

questions.explanation: 他在骑自行车，由于在深雪的下坡路，自行车的“刹车(brakes)”已经无法让他停下来了。A(恐惧)、B(脚)、C(尖叫)不能使自行车停止。
questions.supplement:
A(fears)：语境句：She had to overcome her fears before stepping onto the stage. 固定搭配：overcome fears, live in fear
B(feet)：语境句：After walking for miles, his feet were sore and tired. 固定搭配：stand on one's own feet, drag one's feet
C(screams)：语境句：The terrifying movie was filled with screams from the audience. 固定搭配：let out a scream, hear screams
D(brakes)：语境句：He slammed on the brakes to avoid hitting the dog. 固定搭配：apply the brakes, hit the brakes

questions.explanation: 既然无法停下，他唯一能做的就是“抓紧(hang on)”。hang on tight 是固定搭配，意为“紧紧抓住”。B(闭嘴)、C(躺下)、D(环顾)在即将撞车的紧急时刻不合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(hang on)：语境句：Hang on tight as the roller coaster is about to start! 固定搭配：hang on tight, hang on a minute
B(shut up)：语境句：He rudely told his little sister to shut up. 固定搭配：shut up, keep shut up
C(lie down)：语境句：If you feel dizzy, you'd better lie down and take a rest. 固定搭配：lie down to sleep, lie down and rest
D(look round)：语境句：We had a few hours to look round the ancient city. 固定搭配：look round for sth, look round the corner

questions.explanation: 考查固定习语 in the teeth of...，字面意为“在...的牙齿里”，实际意为“迎着，冒着，在...最剧烈的时候”。此处指“在严冬的严酷中”。
questions.supplement:
A(eyes)：语境句：She looked deeply into his eyes and told the truth. 固定搭配：keep an eye on, catch one's eye
B(teeth)：语境句：He set off on his journey in the teeth of a terrible storm. 固定搭配：in the teeth of (冒着，不顾), brush one's teeth
C(head)：语境句：The successful businessman is the head of a large corporation. 固定搭配：keep one's head, lose one's head
D(back)：语境句：She carried a heavy backpack on her back during the hike. 固定搭配：turn one's back on, behind one's back

questions.explanation: 因为他孤身一人，甚至没有人能“听到(caught)”他的尖叫声。catch 此处意为“捕捉到（声音），听清”。A(回忆)、C(跟随)、D(认出)均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(recalled)：语境句：The old man fondly recalled his childhood days in the countryside. 固定搭配：recall doing sth, recall the past
B(caught)：语境句：I didn't quite catch what you said due to the noise. 固定搭配：catch one's words, catch one's breath
C(followed)：语境句：The little dog followed the boy wherever he went. 固定搭配：follow the rules, follow one's advice
D(recognized)：语境句：I recognized her immediately by the red hat she was wearing. 固定搭配：be widely recognized, recognize sb's voice

questions.explanation: 他深处西伯利亚荒野，距离“最近的(nearest)”人类也有数百英里。表示物理距离最近，选 nearest。
questions.supplement:
A(nearest)：语境句：Could you tell me the way to the nearest hospital? 固定搭配：the nearest exit, nearest and dearest
B(kindest)：语境句：He is one of the kindest people I have ever met. 固定搭配：with kindest regards, the kindest heart
C(strongest)：语境句：Survival of the fittest means the strongest will survive. 固定搭配：the strongest candidate, in the strongest terms
D(poorest)：语境句：The charity provides food and shelter for the poorest families. 固定搭配：the poorest regions, the poorest quality

questions.explanation: 伴随着“CRASH(撞击)”，他脸朝下“摔落/着陆(landed)”进了一个雪堆。land 在此作动词表示“降落，跌落到地上”。
questions.supplement:
A(pushed)：语境句：He pushed the heavy door open and walked into the room. 固定搭配：push forward, push aside
B(stood)：语境句：The brave soldier stood firmly at his post despite the cold. 固定搭配：stand out, stand for
C(landed)：语境句：The plane landed safely at the airport despite the heavy fog. 固定搭配：land on one's feet, safely landed
D(slid)：语境句：The glass slid off the table and crashed onto the floor. 固定搭配：slide down, slide into

questions.explanation: 经历惨烈摔倒后，起初的一两分钟他没动，他甚至不确定自己是否还“活着(alive)”。
questions.supplement:
A(alive)：语境句：It was a miracle that the passengers were found alive after the crash. 固定搭配：keep alive, come alive
B(awake)：语境句：The strong coffee kept me awake all night. 固定搭配：stay awake, wide awake
C(healthy)：语境句：Eating plenty of vegetables and fruits helps you stay healthy. 固定搭配：stay healthy, a healthy diet
D(broken)：语境句：She carefully swept up the pieces of the broken vase. 固定搭配：a broken heart, broken English

questions.explanation: 他慢慢活动了脚趾、手指和鼻子，发现所有的身体部位都“完好无损/在原位(in place)”，即没有骨折或残缺。
questions.supplement:
A(place)：语境句：Make sure everything is in place before the guests arrive. 固定搭配：in place (就位，妥当), take place
B(touch)：语境句：We promised to keep in touch after graduating from high school. 固定搭配：keep in touch, lose touch
C(trouble)：语境句：If you don't follow the rules, you will get into trouble. 固定搭配：in trouble, ask for trouble
D(sight)：语境句：The majestic mountains finally came into sight. 固定搭配：out of sight, catch sight of

questions.explanation: 前文提到他安然无恙，是因为厚厚的积雪缓冲了他的“摔落(fall)”。cushion one's fall 意为“缓冲跌倒的力量”。
questions.supplement:
A(fall)：语境句：The thick snow on the ground cushioned his fall. 固定搭配：cushion one's fall, break one's fall
B(jump)：语境句：With a sudden jump, the cat caught the mouse. 固定搭配：high jump, jump to conclusions
C(dig)：语境句：They had to dig a deep hole to plant the tree. 固定搭配：dig into, dig up
D(rub)：语境句：He had to rub his freezing hands together to keep warm. 固定搭配：rub shoulders with, rub off

questions.explanation: 趴在冰冷的雪里不舒服，因此他慢慢地把自己“拉起/撑起(pulled)”。pull oneself upright 是常见搭配，意为“挣扎着站直”。
questions.supplement:
A(dressed)：语境句：She got up early, washed, and dressed quickly for work. 固定搭配：get dressed, be dressed in
B(hurt)：语境句：He accidentally hurt his leg while playing basketball. 固定搭配：feel hurt, badly hurt
C(pulled)：语境句：He pulled himself upright and continued to walk despite the pain. 固定搭配：pull up, pull oneself together
D(behaved)：语境句：The children behaved very well at the party. 固定搭配：behave well, behave oneself

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“that I've ridden down today（我今天骑下的）”以及上文44题提到“flying down a big hill”，可知他今天在每个骑下坡的“山丘(hill)”上都摔倒了。
questions.supplement:
A(snowdrift)：语境句：The car was completely stuck in a huge snowdrift. 固定搭配：deep snowdrift, stuck in a snowdrift
B(bike)：语境句：He rides his bike to school every day to stay fit. 固定搭配：ride a bike, mountain bike
C(road)：语境句：The road to success is often filled with difficulties. 固定搭配：on the road, hit the road
D(hill)：语境句：They stood at the top of the hill, looking down at the village. 固定搭配：up the hill, over the hill

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be known for something, especially a characteristic
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'famous for'为形容词短语作后置定语，修饰'region'，相当于'which is famous for'。固定搭配 be famous for 表示因某特征而闻名。
vocab_pack.example_en: This city is famous for its ancient architecture.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座城市以其古老的建筑而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: famous for its severe winters

vocab_pack.definition_en: very bad, serious, or extreme
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词 severe 修饰名词 winters，构成偏正短语，表示严寒的冬天。
vocab_pack.example_en: The region is known for its severe weather conditions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个地区以其恶劣的天气条件而闻名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: severe winters

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attempt to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'trying to'是过去进行时的一部分（was trying to），表示当时正在试图做某事。try to do 是固定结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: She tried to solve the problem on her own.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她试图独立解决这个问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was trying to cycle across

vocab_pack.definition_en: to ride a bicycle across a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: cycle 为动词，across 为介词，构成动词短语，后接地点名词。文中用在 try to 后，表示试图骑车穿越。
vocab_pack.example_en: He plans to cycle across the desert next summer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他计划明年夏天骑车穿越沙漠。
vocab_pack.from_passage: cycle across it

vocab_pack.definition_en: extremely cold
vocab_pack.grammar_note: freezing 和 cold 两个形容词连用，起强调作用，修饰 day。freezing 本身有‘冰冻的’意思，加强 cold 的程度。
vocab_pack.example_en: It was a freezing cold morning, so we stayed indoors.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那是一个严寒的早晨，所以我们待在室内。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a freezing cold day

vocab_pack.definition_en: very foolish or unreasonable; mad
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词 crazy 修饰名词 idea，作定语，表示这个想法很疯狂。
vocab_pack.example_en: Most people thought his plan was crazy, but he succeeded.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大多数人认为他的计划很疯狂，但他成功了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a crazy idea

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be correct in one's opinion or judgment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'were right'是一般过去时，主语 they，be 动词用 were，表示他们（之前的看法）是正确的。
vocab_pack.example_en: I think you are right about the cause of the problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我认为你对问题原因的看法是正确的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Maybe they were right

vocab_pack.definition_en: to shake involuntarily, typically from cold, fear, or excitement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'trembling'是过去进行时的现在分词，表示持续发抖的状态。主语 he，was trembling 构成过去进行时。
vocab_pack.example_en: The boy trembled with fear when he heard the loud noise.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 男孩听到巨响时吓得发抖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: he was trembling

vocab_pack.definition_en: suffering from frostbite; having skin damaged by extreme cold
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'frost-bitten'是形容词，与 was 构成系表结构，描述主语被冻伤的状态。注意拼写有连字符。
vocab_pack.example_en: After hours in the snow, his fingers were frostbitten.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在雪地里待了几个小时后，他的手指冻伤了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He was frost-bitten

vocab_pack.definition_en: as a confused or unclear shape; without clear details
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，修饰动词 passed，表示树木经过时看起来模糊一片。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scenery passed in a blur as the train sped by.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 火车飞驰而过，窗外的景色一片模糊。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Trees passed in a blur

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be unable to cease or halt an action
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'couldn't stop'是 can't stop 的过去式，表示当时无法停下来。can't stop 为固定搭配，后接动词原形或独立使用。
vocab_pack.example_en: Once he starts laughing, he can't stop.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他一旦笑起来就停不下来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: He couldn't stop

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to express a future event that is planned or expected
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'was going to'是过去将来时结构，表示从过去某个时间点看将要发生的事情。be going to 按人称和时态变化。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am going to visit my grandparents this weekend.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个周末我打算去看望祖父母。
vocab_pack.from_passage: This was going to end badly

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have an unfortunate or disastrous conclusion
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 结局糟糕；以不好的方式结束
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词 end 与副词 badly 搭配，作谓语，表示事情的结果会很糟糕。文中 was going to end badly 为过去将来时。
vocab_pack.example_en: If you don't follow the rules, this project will end badly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果你不遵守规则，这个项目会以失败告终。
vocab_pack.from_passage: end badly

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be expected or intended to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'was supposed to'是一般过去时被动结构，主语 it，表示这件事原本应该是好玩的。be supposed to 后接动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: You are supposed to hand in your homework by Friday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你应该在周五前交作业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: It was supposed to have been fun

vocab_pack.definition_en: enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'fun'是不可数名词，作表语，与 have been 构成系表结构，表示原本应该是乐趣。
vocab_pack.example_en: We had so much fun at the party last night.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 昨晚我们在派对上玩得很开心。
vocab_pack.from_passage: have been fun

vocab_pack.definition_en: used for emphasis in negative sentences, meaning 'not in any way'
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'not at all'用于否定句 'not fun at all'，加强否定语气，表示一点乐趣也没有。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am not tired at all after the long walk.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 走了那么长的路，我一点也不累。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not fun at all

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be on the point of doing something; to be just going to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'was about to'表示过去某个时间点即将发生的动作，后接动词原形 crash。be about to 比 be going to 更紧迫。
vocab_pack.example_en: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我正要离开时电话响了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Tom was about to crash.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to hit something violently, causing damage; to have an accident
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'crash'用在 be about to 后，为动词原形，表示即将发生的碰撞。
vocab_pack.example_en: The driver crashed into a tree because of the icy road.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 由于路面结冰，司机撞到了一棵树上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was about to crash

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move or travel downwards very quickly (like flying)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'flying down'是过去进行时的现在分词，表示当时正在快速向下冲。fly down 为动词短语，后接地点名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The skier flew down the mountain at an incredible speed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 滑雪者以惊人的速度冲下山。
vocab_pack.from_passage: was flying down a big hill

vocab_pack.definition_en: as fast as possible; at the maximum speed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，修饰 was flying down，表示以最快速度飞驰。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cheetah can run at top speed for short distances.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 猎豹能在短距离内以最高速度奔跑。
vocab_pack.from_passage: at top speed

vocab_pack.definition_en: a large amount of snow that is thick and covers the ground deeply
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词 deep 修饰名词 snow，在句中作介词 in 的宾语，表示在很深的雪中。
vocab_pack.example_en: The hikers struggled to walk through the deep snow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 徒步旅行者艰难地在深雪中行走。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in deep snow

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: make him come to a stop
vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause or force someone to perform an action
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使某人做某事（不带to的不定式）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'make him come to a stop'是 make 的使役结构，宾语 him 后接不带 to 的不定式 come。注意语法规则：make + 宾语 + 动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher made the students rewrite their essays.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师让学生们重写作文。
vocab_pack.from_passage: make him come to a stop

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop moving; to halt
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，在 make 后不带 to。文中表示使自行车停下来。come to a stop 是固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: The train slowly came to a stop at the station.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 火车慢慢地在车站停了下来。
vocab_pack.from_passage: come to a stop

vocab_pack.definition_en: to hold something firmly without letting go
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'hang on tight'在'All he could do was hang on tight'中是不带 to 的不定式（因为前面有do）。hang on 是动词短语，tight 是副词强化。
vocab_pack.example_en: When the roller coaster started, I hung on tight to the safety bar.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 过山车启动时，我紧紧抓住安全杠。
vocab_pack.from_passage: hang on tight

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to compare two things, saying one is more bad or unpleasant than the other
vocab_pack.grammar_note: worse 是 bad 的比较级，than 引出比较对象。文中比较 waiting for the crash 和 the crash itself，表示等待比碰撞本身更糟糕。
vocab_pack.example_en: The second half of the movie was even worse than the first.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 电影的后半部分比前半部分还要差。
vocab_pack.from_passage: worse than the crash itself

vocab_pack.definition_en: to remain in a place or delay action until a particular event or person arrives
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'Waiting for'是动名词短语作主语，wait for 表示等待（碰撞）。原形 wait for 后接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She waited for the bus for over an hour.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她等公交车等了一个多小时。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Waiting for the crash

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have no other option except to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'had no choice but to'是过去时，have 变为 had，表示当时除了尖叫别无选择。后接动词原形 scream。
vocab_pack.example_en: With the deadline approaching, we had no choice but to work overtime.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 截止日期临近，我们别无选择只能加班。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had no choice but to scream

vocab_pack.definition_en: in direct opposition or confrontation with something; directly facing a difficulty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'in the teeth of winter'是介词短语作状语，表示迎着冬天的严寒（可能指直接面对寒风）。这是一个固定习语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The ship sailed on in the teeth of the storm.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 船只迎着风暴继续航行。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in the teeth of winter

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce the impact or effect of a fall or blow; to provide protection
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'cushioned'是过去分词，与 had 构成过去完成时，表示雪已经缓冲了他的坠落。cushion 作为及物动词，宾语 his fall。
vocab_pack.example_en: The thick grass cushioned the child's fall from the swing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 厚厚的草地缓冲了孩子从秋千上摔下来的冲击。
vocab_pack.from_passage: had cushioned his fall

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use one's strength to raise one's body to a vertical or sitting position
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 把自己拉起来；坐直或站直
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 文中'pulled himself upright'是一般过去时，pulled 是过去式，himself 是反身代词，upright 是副词。短语中 oneself 随主语变化。
vocab_pack.example_en: After falling, he pulled himself upright and continued walking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 摔倒后，他爬起来继续走路。
vocab_pack.from_passage: pulled himself upright

section_2_word_form.passage:
With a pair of scissors, a couple of rubber bands and ribbons, Liang Qinzhang can turn twigs (细枝), branches and flowers into pieces of art.
The man in his 60s demonstrated traditional flower arrangement for gardening [56] (enthusiast) in Beijing during the Spring Festival in late January 2023. "As Chinese tradition goes, I use magnolias (木兰), [57] blossoms bring good fortune, to show harmony and happiness," Liang explained. "Since ancient times, different materials [58] (apply) to create a grand effect for special occasions." At the end of the session, Liang hung festive items on the plants [59] (highlight) the holiday atmosphere and suggested his audience do the same.
Liang held the demonstration in [60] belief that it should be easy for the traditional art, [61] (name) a national intangible (非物质的) cultural heritage in 2008, to be enjoyed by more people. "It places more focus [62] the expression of moods and the personalized meaning of the materials used," he said.
"Chinese flower arrangement is influenced by traditional Chinese culture and tends to be about [63] (nature) beauty, rather than artificial creation," Liang said. "Therefore, we need to go out more often to observe plants and [64] (far) understand the ecological habits of the flowering branches, through which we can know how to better arrange [65] (they)."

questions.explanation: enthusiast（爱好者）为可数名词，在此处泛指园艺爱好者这一群体，且前面没有不定冠词，故需使用复数形式 enthusiasts。
questions.supplement: 正确形(enthusiasts)：语境句：The classic car show attracted thousands of enthusiasts from all over the country. 固定搭配：sports enthusiasts, car enthusiasts。原词enthusiast其它变形：enthusiasm(n. 热情), enthusiastic(adj. 热情的), enthusiastically(adv. 热情地)。

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，逗号后为非限制性定语从句，修饰先行词 magnolias（木兰）。从句中 blossoms 作主语，与先行词为所属关系（木兰的花朵），故填关系代词 whose。
questions.supplement: 正确形(whose)：语境句：The author, whose latest book became a bestseller, will give a speech tomorrow. 固定搭配：whose name is, a person whose...。原词who其它变形：whom(pron. 宾格), whoever(pron. 无论谁)。

questions.explanation: 句中时间状语为 "Since ancient times"，谓语动词需用现在完成时。主语 materials 与 apply（应用）之间为被动关系，因此使用现在完成时的被动语态 have been applied。
questions.supplement: 正确形(have been applied)：语境句：These strict rules have been applied to all employees since last year. 固定搭配：apply to (适用于), apply for (申请)。原词apply其它变形：application(n. 申请/应用), applicant(n. 申请人), applicable(adj. 适用的)。

questions.explanation: 梁在植物上挂节日物品的“目的”是为了突出节日气氛，在句中作目的状语，应使用动词不定式 to highlight。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to highlight)：语境句：The teacher used colorful slides to highlight the main points of the lesson. 固定搭配：highlight the importance, a major highlight。原词highlight其它变形：highlights(n. 精彩部分), highlighted(adj. 突出的)。

questions.explanation: 考查冠词及固定搭配。in the belief that... 为固定表达，意为“相信/怀着……的信念”，后接同位语从句，需用定冠词 the。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the)：语境句：She worked hard in the belief that her efforts would eventually pay off. 固定搭配：in the belief that (相信...), hold the belief。定冠词the其它常见搭配：the same as, the number of。

questions.explanation: 分析句子可知，空处在句中作后置定语，修饰 traditional art。name 与 traditional art 构成逻辑上的动宾被动关系（被命名为），故使用过去分词 named。
questions.supplement: 正确形(named)：语境句：The local museum, named after a famous scientist, is open to the public for free. 固定搭配：be named after, namely (adv. 即)。原词name其它变形：namely(adv. 也就是), nameless(adj. 无名的)。

questions.explanation: 考查介词。place/put focus on... 是固定搭配，意为“把焦点放在……上 / 重点关注……”，故填 on。
questions.supplement: 正确形(on)：语境句：Nowadays, schools place more focus on students' mental health. 固定搭配：focus on (关注), place focus on (把焦点放在...上)。其它常见介词搭配：depend on, rely on。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词 beauty（美），需将其转换为形容词形式 natural，表示“自然的美（natural beauty）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(natural)：语境句：The national park is famous for its stunning natural beauty. 固定搭配：natural beauty, natural resources。原词nature其它变形：naturally(adv. 自然地), unnatural(adj. 不自然的)。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰动词 understand，意为“进一步理解”，需使用 far 的抽象副词比较级形式 further。
questions.supplement: 正确形(further)：语境句：If you need any further information, please feel free to contact us. 固定搭配：further study, go a step further。原词far其它变形：farther(adv./adj. 物理距离更远), farthest/furthest(adv./adj. 最远)。

questions.explanation: 空处作动词 arrange（布置）的宾语，指代前文的 plants / flowering branches（复数名词），需用代词的宾格形式 them。
questions.supplement: 正确形(them)：语境句：The books are heavy, so please handle them with care. 固定搭配：arrange them, look after them。原词they其它变形：their(pron. 他们的), theirs(pron. 名词性物主代词), themselves(pron. 他们自己)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a set of two things that are used together
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰 scissors，表示数量；a pair of 后接复数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She bought a pair of new shoes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她买了一双新鞋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: With a pair of scissors, a couple of rubber bands and ribbons...

vocab_pack.definition_en: a thin branch of a tree
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 twigs，与 branches 并列作 turn 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The bird used twigs to build its nest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鸟儿用细枝筑巢。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...can turn twigs, branches and flowers into pieces of art.

vocab_pack.definition_en: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 branches，与 twigs 并列。
vocab_pack.example_en: The branches of the tree were covered with leaves.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那棵树的树枝上长满了叶子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...can turn twigs, branches and flowers into pieces of art.

vocab_pack.definition_en: an object that is made by an artist
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 pieces of art，作 turn...into 的宾语补足语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This sculpture is a beautiful piece of art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座雕塑是一件美丽的艺术品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...turn twigs, branches and flowers into pieces of art.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show how something works or is done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时 demonstrated，主语为 The man in his 60s，表示过去发生的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher demonstrated the experiment to the class.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师向全班演示了实验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The man in his 60s demonstrated traditional flower arrangement for gardening enthusiasts...

vocab_pack.definition_en: the art of arranging flowers in an attractive way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作 demonstrated 的宾语，是传统插花的一种形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: She studied flower arrangement at a Japanese school.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在日本学校学习插花。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...demonstrated traditional flower arrangement for gardening enthusiasts...

vocab_pack.definition_en: a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 enthusiasts，与 gardening 搭配，作介词 for 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is a car enthusiast.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他是个汽车爱好者。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...demonstrated traditional flower arrangement for gardening enthusiasts in Beijing...

vocab_pack.definition_en: the Chinese New Year celebration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 专有名词，前加定冠词 the，原文中作 during 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The Spring Festival is a time for family reunions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 春节是家人团聚的时刻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...in Beijing during the Spring Festival in late January 2023.

vocab_pack.definition_en: according to tradition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定表达，as 引导方式状语从句，goes 为固定用法。
vocab_pack.example_en: As tradition goes, we eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 按照传统，我们在除夕吃饺子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "As Chinese tradition goes, I use magnolias..."

vocab_pack.definition_en: a tree or shrub with large, sweet-smelling flowers
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 magnolias，作 use 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The magnolia tree in the garden blooms every spring.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 花园里的木兰树每年春天开花。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...I use magnolias, whose blossoms bring good fortune..."

vocab_pack.definition_en: a flower or mass of flowers on a tree or bush
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 blossoms，作 bring 的主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The cherry blossoms are in full bloom.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 樱花盛开了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...whose blossoms bring good fortune..."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause good luck or success
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时，主语 blossoms 为复数，所以动词原形 bring。
vocab_pack.example_en: Wearing this charm is said to bring good fortune.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 据说佩戴这个护身符能带来好运。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...whose blossoms bring good fortune to show harmony and happiness."

vocab_pack.definition_en: a state of peaceful agreement and unity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与 happiness 并列作 show 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The two nations lived in harmony.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这两个国家和谐相处。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...to show harmony and happiness."

vocab_pack.definition_en: from long ago in history up to the present
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，since 表示“自……以来”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Since ancient times, people have used herbs for medicine.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 自古以来，人们就用草药治病。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "Since ancient times, different materials have been applied..."

vocab_pack.definition_en: the things that are used to make something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 materials，作主语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Building materials are expensive these days.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如今建筑材料很贵。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...different materials have been applied to create a grand effect..."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to use something in a practical way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为 have been applied，现在完成时的被动语态，applied 是过去分词。
vocab_pack.example_en: New technology is being applied in many industries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新技术正被应用于许多行业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...different materials have been applied to create a grand effect for special occasions."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to produce a large, impressive impact
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语作目的状语，修饰 have been applied。
vocab_pack.example_en: The fireworks created a grand effect on New Year's Eve.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 烟花在除夕夜创造了宏伟的效果。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...to create a grand effect for special occasions."

vocab_pack.definition_en: an important event or celebration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式，作介词 for 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She only wears this dress on special occasions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她只在特殊场合穿这条裙子。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...create a grand effect for special occasions."

vocab_pack.definition_en: at the final part of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，原文中作时间状语，表示会议结束时。
vocab_pack.example_en: At the end of the movie, everyone clapped.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 电影结束时，大家都鼓掌了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: At the end of the session, Liang hung festive items on the plants...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something so that it is supported from above with no support from below
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时 hung，是 hang 的过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: He hung a picture on the wall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他把一幅画挂在墙上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...Liang hung festive items on the plants to highlight the holiday atmosphere...

vocab_pack.definition_en: objects used to celebrate a festival
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式，作 hung 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We decorated the room with festive items for the party.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们用节日装饰品装饰房间来开派对。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...Liang hung festive items on the plants...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to emphasize or make something more noticeable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式 to highlight，作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The report highlights the need for change.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这份报告强调了变革的必要性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...to highlight the holiday atmosphere and suggested his audience do the same.

vocab_pack.definition_en: the mood or feeling of a place or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作 highlight 的宾语，指节日氛围。
vocab_pack.example_en: The candles created a romantic atmosphere.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 蜡烛营造出一种浪漫的氛围。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...to highlight the holiday atmosphere...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put forward an idea or plan for someone to consider
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时 suggested，后接宾语从句（省略 that 和 should）。
vocab_pack.example_en: I suggest you see a doctor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我建议你去看医生。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...suggested his audience do the same.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to perform the same action as someone else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动词短语，原文中省略 to 的不定式，作 suggest 的宾语从句谓语。
vocab_pack.example_en: If she jumps, I will do the same.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 如果她跳，我也做同样的事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...suggested his audience do the same.

vocab_pack.definition_en: because you believe that something is true
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作状语，that 引导同位语从句说明 belief 的内容。
vocab_pack.example_en: He acted in the belief that he was doing the right thing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他这样做是相信自己在做正确的事。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Liang held the demonstration in the belief that it should be easy...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a name to someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为过去分词 named，作定语修饰 the traditional art，表示被命名。
vocab_pack.example_en: The park was named after a famous poet.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这座公园以一位著名诗人命名。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...named a national intangible cultural heritage in 2008...

vocab_pack.definition_en: cultural traditions, practices, and knowledge passed down through generations
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作宾语补足语，与 national 连用。
vocab_pack.example_en: Peking opera is a form of intangible cultural heritage.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 京剧是一种非物质文化遗产。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...named a national intangible cultural heritage in 2008...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give special attention to something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般现在时第三人称单数 places，后接 focus on。
vocab_pack.example_en: The course places focus on practical skills.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该课程重点放在实用技能上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "It places more focus on the expression of moods and the personalized meaning..."

vocab_pack.definition_en: instead of; in preference to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 连接并列成分，原文中连接 natural beauty 和 artificial creation。
vocab_pack.example_en: I prefer tea rather than coffee.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...tends to be about natural beauty, rather than artificial creation."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to leave one's home to go outside
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与 need to 连用，作原形不定式。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should go out for a walk.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该出去散步。
vocab_pack.from_passage: "...we need to go out more often to observe plants..."

vocab_pack.definition_en: to watch carefully
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式，与 go out 并列作目的状语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Scientists observe animal behavior in the wild.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 科学家在野外观察动物行为。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...to observe plants and further understand the ecological habits...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to a greater degree or extent
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为 far 的比较级，修饰动词 understand。
vocab_pack.example_en: We need to discuss this further.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们需要进一步讨论这个。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...and further understand the ecological habits of the flowering branches...

vocab_pack.definition_en: the natural conditions under which a plant or animal lives
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为复数形式 habits，作 understand 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This study examines the ecological habits of birds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项研究考察了鸟类的生态习性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...understand the ecological habits of the flowering branches...

vocab_pack.definition_en: to put things in a particular order or position
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为不定式，how to arrange 中的原形动词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She arranged the flowers in a vase.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她把花插在花瓶里。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ...through which we can know how to better arrange them.
